candidates.summary: The diff makes the defineFauxCopy slot check unconditional, while its sibling invariant check in defineNew, which the ADR calls enforced, still runs only under debugAssert
candidates.failure_scenario: A caller appending a second slot for a name at or past numFauxCopiedNames() in a release build gets a silent duplicate, and GetLocalIndex resolves every later use to the new slot
candidates.verify_by: grep every defineNew caller and confirm each one returns before appending a name already at or past the boundary

completeness: Catalog: VM semantics vs Go and Type-check & preprocess are the classes this diff touches; candidate 1 is the preprocess one. Determinism, gas, realm state, caller identity, coins, storage deposit, global state, twin inputs and stored data are untouched by these five files.

VM-fault recoverability: the two preprocess panics candidate 1 reaches (a string panic and a Go index out of range) are recovered by the REPL's RunStatements and by doRecoverQuery on qeval; addpkg and node boot never reach them, since DeclarationErrors rejects `_ :=` there.

Sibling sweep by shape: defineFauxCopy has two callers (preprocess.go:1056, :4269); the copy loop at :4269 indexes names the parent holds, and a parent never holds `_`. The other debugAssert guard on the same invariant is candidate 2.
